policies.title: Kuwaiti ordinary passports: advance embassy visa destinations
policies.summary: Kuwait's current government table directs ordinary Kuwaiti passport holders to obtain an embassy-issued visa before visiting these destinations.
conditions: Ordinary Kuwaiti passport and short visitor travel; apply through the relevant embassy before departure, with final issuance and admission remaining discretionary.

policies.title: Kuwaiti ordinary passports: Botswana visa-free visits
policies.summary: Botswana has lifted visa requirements for Kuwaiti visitors, matching Kuwait's current ordinary-passport table.
conditions: Ordinary Kuwaiti passport and short visitor travel; length-of-stay, entry documentation and final admission remain separate.

policies.title: Kuwaiti ordinary passports: Panama visa-free visits
policies.summary: Kuwaiti visitors may enter Panama without a visa for a short stay.
conditions: Ordinary Kuwaiti passport and short visitor travel, normally no more than three months; entry documentation and final admission remain separate.

policies.title: Kuwaiti ordinary passports: other current visa-free destinations
policies.summary: Kuwait's current government table identifies Jordan, Sudan, Tunisia and Ukraine as visa-free for ordinary Kuwaiti passports.
conditions: Ordinary Kuwaiti passport and short visitor travel; destination-specific stay limits, entry documentation and final admission remain separate.

policies.title: Kuwaiti ordinary passports: current visa-on-arrival destinations
policies.summary: Kuwait's current government table identifies arrival-issued visitor visas for ordinary Kuwaiti passport holders at these destinations.
conditions: Ordinary Kuwaiti passport and short visitor travel through an eligible port; fees, supporting documents, stay limits and final admission remain destination-specific.
